items.title: Open seller sign-up lets attackers mass-create seller accounts to phish buyers in chat
Uploaded chat photos readable by anyone who has or guesses the image URL
Full chat history stored unprotected in a local database on the phone
Unbounded photo uploads let anyone fill server storage and run up cost
Uploaded image files are not validated, so a seller can push malicious content into a buyer's app
Photo metadata leaks the sender's home location to a stranger
